key.name: username
key.description: The GitHub account used to load contribution data.

key.name: refresh-interval-minutes
key.description: How often the extension should refresh GitHub data.

key.name: github-token
key.description: Personal access token used to load private contributions and avoid rate limits.

key.name: cached-result
key.description: Stores the last successful contribution payload for faster startup.

key.name: color-theme
key.description: Palette used to style contribution cells.

key.description: Custom color hex for highest contribution level.

key.name: custom-bg-color
key.description: Custom color hex for level 0 cells.
